title: zl.indexmap
description: build a list from elements at given indexes

messages.description: performs the operation again on the last received list
list to take the elements from
0-based indexes of the elements to take
the elements at the given indexes

arguments.description: 0-based indexes of the elements to take

methods.description: clears the mode's arguments and the data received in both inlets
sets the maximum list size, 1 to 32767

body: [zl.indexmap] builds a new list from the incoming one, taking the elements at the indexes (0-based) set by the arguments or the right inlet. Indexes out of range are clamped to 0.
